title: Live Publication Preview Application Boundary
released_boundary: ProjectPagePublicationPreviewService: a preview-only application-service boundary that consumes publishable project state from live L0 PublishableProjectProfileCandidate and J0 PublicationReadiness/PagesActionPreparation instances, and produces deterministic public-safe preview results with canonical evidence and refusal semantics.
stated_consumer_purpose: A later desktop integration milestone can connect the Publish Preview surface to a real safe preview application service rather than raw compiler fixtures.
dirty_state_before: Pre-existing dirty files from lanes S0, S2, S4 in frontend/desktop/ and rig_relay/desktop/gateway/
dirty_state_after: Same pre-existing dirty files preserved. No other-lane files absorbed into S3 commit.
completed_work: Created ProjectPagePublicationPreviewService in _service.py — typed application-service boundary
Added PreviewEvidenceReceipt, PreviewRefusalCode, PublicationPreviewRefusal, PublicationPreviewResult models

Enhanced _safety.py with deployment overclaim detection (7 patterns: deploy to production, published to pages, live at https://, deployed successfully, auto-deploy, CI/CD pipeline deployed, publication complete)
Added mistral_key regex pattern to secret detection
Rewrote tests to use real L0 model construction (PublishableProjectProfileCandidate) instead of dict fixtures
Added 17 new service-boundary tests covering refusal, evidence, determinism, safety, schema mismatch
Updated __init__.py to export new service and models
Added pyproject.toml per-file-ignores for publication/_safety.py and publication/_service.py
intentionally_deferred_work: Desktop frontend wiring (P0 Gridline Interface consumption of preview results)
GitHub Pages deployment pipeline (separate authority, out of scope)
Live GitHub Pages API integration for publication_readiness (J0 boundary consumed as typed model, API calls deferred)
Cross-lane integration testing with P0 desktop gateway
Portfolio site compilation surface (project_page only in this lane)
remaining_seams: Desktop cockpit Publish Preview surface → ProjectPagePublicationPreviewService wiring (P0 integration milestone)
GitHub Pages deployment action (requires separate deployment authority, not preview-only)
Portfolio site compilation (multi-project synthesis, requires DeveloperCorpusIndex)
freeze_condition: Lane S3 is frozen pending the named integration milestone that wires the desktop Publish Preview surface to ProjectPagePublicationPreviewService. Reopens only for a concrete defect inside this boundary, the named integration milestone, or a user-directed architectural revision.
pyproject_toml_shared_boundary_note: pyproject.toml contains pre-existing per-file-ignores from lanes S2/S4 (rig_relay/desktop/gateway/_content_light.py, rig_relay/desktop/gateway/_authority.py) which were in the working tree before this lane began. These are additive per-file-ignores only and do not affect lane-boundary safety.
